name: AVIAR
description: AVIAR (Advanced Vascular Intervention Assist Robot) is a teleoperated endovascular robotic system developed by South Korean medical device manufacturer LN Robotics for percutaneous coronary intervention (PCI). The system consists of a table-mounted multi-channel robotic drive unit capable of simultaneously loading and independently manipulating multiple interventional devices—including guidewires, balloon catheters, and stents—controlled by the physician from a radiation-shielded console with haptic/force monitoring. AVIAR received regulatory approval from South Korea's Ministry of Food and Drug Safety (MFDS) in 2023 and has been clinically evaluated in multi-center coronary intervention trials.

publications.title: Safety and Feasibility of Robot-Assisted Percutaneous Coronary Intervention Using the AVIAR 2.0 System: A Prospective, Multi-Center, Single-Arm, Open, Investigator-Initiated, Post-Approval Clinical Trial
